situations.neutral: neutral lane (fronts fighting at the lane cell, equal power)
situations.own_pushing: own wave pushing (own front at own +1, next to the enemy tower)
situations.enemy_pushing: enemy wave pushing (enemy front at own -1, next to the own tower)
situations.stacked: own front stacked (>= 16 HP) in contact
situations.defending: defending (enemy mass under the own tower)
situations.freeze_like: freeze-like (enemy front at own -1, own front in the own tower cell)
